# gpui-base 0.10.0

This copy of the base crate used by gpui-kit is licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE-APACHE).
The source package is gpui-base 0.10.0 from crates.io.

The fuzukue contributors modified the dependency manifest and patched editor
display, wrapping and indentation, focus and popup placement, and scrolling.
Text changes cover document layout, Markdown hooks, inline object layout,
selection and copying, styling, and CJK emphasis marks. The application
supplies its own spacing rules through the added hooks.
